_meta.purpose: Durable master-data mapping for writing an ERP Sales Order back into AutoCount (HOUZS CENTURY [LIVE]) as an AutoCount Sales Order. Company 1 (Houzs Century) only; 2990 excluded. Harvested read-only from AutoCount 2.2 maintenance screens on 2026-08-06.
_meta.source: AutoCount Accounting 2.2 64-bit, HOUZS CENTURY SDN BHD [LIVE], user ADMIN
notes: AutoCount has NO create-SO endpoint yet; the .NET middleware only exposes updateFromSheet + update-udf-dates. Writeback needs a new AutoCount-SDK create path. This file is the data that path will consume.
Never write AutoCount accounting tables via raw SQL; go through the AutoCount SDK/UI so business logic runs.
DocNo strategy: AutoCount document is populated directly from what we write, so the ERP doc_no becomes the AutoCount DocNo directly (owner confirmed 2026-08-06).

debtor.rule: Every writeback SO uses DebtorCode=300-C002 and overwrites DebtorName with the actual customer name (free text). No per-customer debtor alignment needed.

line.composed_variants_description: ItemDescription (Description 2) — the full composed variant string

payment.note: SO is non-financial in AutoCount. PAYEMENT UDF (free text, e.g. receipt ref) + SOUDF_BALANCE carry info only; real receipts are a separate AR document + endpoint that does not exist.

branding_note: HOUZS was ADDED to the AutoCount BRANDING UDF list on 2026-08-06 (via User Defined List Maintenance UI). AutoCount BRANDING options are now: AKEMI, MYLATEX, DUNLOPILLO, ZANOTTI, ERGOTEX, NONE, HOUZS.
location_note: AutoCount SalesLocation uses SHORT codes; ERP uses long/free-text. JB & Kuantan have no dedicated AutoCount location and fall in the KL/Balakong delivery region per the ERP postcode->zone model (zone-classify.ts); KL warehouse serves central/south/east, PG serves the north, SBH=Sabah.
venue_note: AutoCount SOUDF_VENUE is a controlled dropdown of ~95 options. ERP venue strings normalise to the AC option (naming differs by SOLO suffix / spelling). Full AC venue list captured in autocount-venue-options.txt if needed.

agent_map_fuzzy_to_confirm.Ethan: ETHAN SOO (or ETHAN SOO JIA XIAN)

agent_excluded.reason: 2990 staff (out of scope) or non-sales/test accounts — no AutoCount Houzs Century agent needed

sofa.rule: AutoCount holds ONE stock item per sofa MODEL per supplier (SET UOM, e.g. DSL-8038 SOFA, AMN-SF9028 SOFA, HOK-5530 SOFA). Our per-compartment ERP SKUs (8030-2S, 9028-L(RHF)...) collapse to the parent AutoCount code for the line's SUPPLIER, with the compartment (2L, 3S, CNR...) written into Description 2. No per-compartment AutoCount items exist.
